consumed_rules: universal user is not permanently Player or GM
cadence and connectivity orthogonal to context
service and AI actors have no independent human authority
proposal and decision authority remain separate
AI has no decision modification approval denial or commit authority
local drafts and calculations are nonauthoritative
local draft versus authoritative state distinction
AI cannot bypass permissions proposal approval version checks idempotency provenance or owner gates
AI may prepare drafts and proposals
AI failure has deterministic manual fallback
separate AI feature context tool provider cost and retention permissions
field relationship count history and projection filtering
AI does not inherit initiating user authority beyond filtered task context
Campaign and Session are governed ordinary state
Session uses immutable launch snapshot and Event history
service actors cannot create independent role ownership entitlement or launch authority

reconciliation_findings.issue: AutoGM name could be misread as a human GM role
reconciliation_findings.resolution: AutoGM is a mode/profile; the controller is a nonhuman service actor authorized by explicit delegated capabilities, never assigned global GM role.

reconciliation_findings.issue: Optional AI contract forbids privileged hidden GM data, but AutoGM orchestration may require hidden scenario truth
reconciliation_findings.resolution: Machine-private scenario truth is consumed by the governed deterministic scenario package/controller projection; optional AI receives only a task-filtered presentation projection and does not automatically receive raw scenario-private state.

reconciliation_findings.issue: Automation could be mistaken for authority to choose for a Player
reconciliation_findings.resolution: Every operation is classified automatic, bounded automatic, proposal required, human required, or prohibited; explicit Player intent remains human-required unless a narrow repeat/routine preference is itself explicitly granted.

reconciliation_findings.issue: Closing the app could accidentally become permission for unattended play
reconciliation_findings.resolution: Exit/disconnect is not authority. Runs explicitly declare foreground-only or bounded-background behavior; initial AutoGM defaults to foreground-only.

reconciliation_findings.issue: Automated play could fork ordinary Campaign state into separate saves
reconciliation_findings.resolution: Domain Events and ordinary persistence remain the sole authoritative game/workspace state; run records contain execution/provenance only.

reconciliation_findings.issue: Connected Cozy could let one controller inherit all participant authority
reconciliation_findings.resolution: Each participant keeps independent subject/context authority; no participant may delegate another participant's Personal authority and shared resources remain domain-governed.
